title: We decided to stop optimizing for how long you spend on our app.
body:
Most news apps are built like slot machines. They want you to scroll forever so they can serve more ads. We took a different approach when building the feed for Headlinne.

We intentionally capped the number of articles we show you each day. Instead of trying to keep you glued to your screen, our goal is to give you the most relevant update possible and then let you get back to your day.

It sounds counterintuitive for a tech company. But we believe the value of a news app isn't in how much time you waste. It is in how much time you save while staying informed.

We use AI to filter out the noise and surface only what matters to you personally. Once you have read your daily briefing, the feed stops. No infinite scroll. No junk. Just the news you actually need.
cta: See how we are rethinking the way you get your news at HEADLINNE.com.
